items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: We also, oh yeah there were a couple of other trombone players too, Ron Wilkins, a phenomenal trombone player.

ctx.x: Yeah I give Dr. Vollmer a lot of credit for the audaciousness of sort of what he does in handling the logistics and all of that. There’s a lot of passion there.

Well Doc, you know Doc was part of the show as well because Doc made a point of informing the audience of the history and the importance of the development of the band and this sound and this music. You know? He made — his opening remarks were very powerful and very much needed. And the way he pulled people together, and the way he cared about people. Doc cares about people. You know? Doc would make sure cats had — he would make sure there were gigs because he said these musicians who made all this great music,…
Well I want to thank you for your time and for your significant contributions to the music. You’ve found a way to perform and sort of do public service and keep the music alive, and I appreciate it.
